CALCULATION METHOD

Formulas & data sources

Blending

H + SH + L = 100%. Volume shares are fractions: 40% = 0.40.

Inlet salt = Σ(share × cargo salt)
Inlet BS&W = Σ(share × cargo BS&W)
Predicted outlet = inlet × (1 − efficiency)

Supply & inventory

Daily demand = capacity × share
Light target = daily light demand × buffer days
Coverage = usable inventory ÷ daily light demand
Additional inventory = max(0, target − inventory)

Coverage requires daily light demand >0 and an inventory value. Rounding is for display only; screening uses full precision.

Data sources & verification

SOLVENT T is developed by ZEKINDO. Baseline inputs and formulas follow the SOLVENT T dashboard brief. Initial supplier names are editable reference labels.

Reference identifies baseline inputs. Assumption identifies estimates or edited values. Test result identifies values the user marks as measured. Calculated outputs depend on the selected inputs.

Predicted salt <2 PTB meets the salt screening threshold. Blend acceptance also requires compatibility, outlet BS&W <0.05%, and TAN and metals within unit limits. Confirm TAN and metals limits separately.

Inventory, shipments, and test status are entered manually. Live operational connections and margin optimization are outside this prototype.
